 "content": "def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Uniform separator rows/columns partition the picture into small panels.
    sep_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] not in (0,)]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][c] not in (0,)]
    # Keep only actual dividers that are shared by a row/column crossing.
    divider_colors = set(grid[r][0] for r in sep_rows) & set(grid[0][c] for c in sep_cols)
    if divider_colors:
        color = next(iter(divider_colors))
        sep_rows = [r for r in sep_rows if grid[r][0] == color]
        sep_cols = [c for c in sep_cols if grid[0][c] == color]
    else:
        # ARC divider color is the color occurring along complete separator lines.
        color = max(set(grid[r][0] for r in sep_rows) | set(grid[0][c] for c in sep_cols), key=lambda x: sum(v == x for row in grid for v in row))
        sep_rows = [r for r in sep_rows if grid[r][0] == color]
        sep_cols = [c for c in sep_cols if grid[0][c] == color]
    row_bounds = [-1] + sep_rows + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + sep_cols + [w]
    panels = []
    colors = {}
    for i in range(len(row_bounds)-1):
        for j in range(len(col_bounds)-1):
            cells = [grid[r][c] for r in range(row_bounds[i]+1, row_bounds[i+1]) for c in range(col_bounds[j]+1, col_bounds[j+1])]
            panels.append(cells)
            for v in cells:
                colors[v] = colors.get(v, 0) + 1
    background = max(colors, key=colors.get)
    marks = [v for v in colors if v != background]
    accent = max(marks, key=lambda v: colors[v]) if marks else background
    out = []
    k = 0
    for i in range(len(row_bounds)-1):
        row = []
        for j in range(len(col_bounds)-1):
            row.append(1 if sum(v == accent for v in panels[k]) == 2 else background)
            k += 1
        out.append(row)
    return out
"
}
